sources.storable: CLAUDE.md Section 11: ~0 C, 70-75% RH, ~6-8 months good-condition storage
sources.sl_ref_hours: 4 months (2,880 h) of ambient storage in a ventilated structure, the period over which the losses used for alpha were measured: Gorrepati et al., Post-harvest losses in different varieties of onion, Indian Journal of Horticulture (DOGR, rabi 2013-14 and 2014-15), https://journal.iahs.org.in/index.php/ijh/article/view/321
sources.sl_ref_hours_range: Shelf lives that give the trial's two total losses (35.87% Bhima Shakti, 26.66% Bhima Kiran) at alpha 0.31: 0.31 x 2880 / loss
sources.q10: Derived from UC Davis respiration rates for whole dry onions, 3-4 mL CO2/kg.h at 0-5 C and 27-29 at 25-27 C (midpoints over 23.5 C), https://postharvest.ucdavis.edu/produce-facts-sheets/onions-dry (read through a search excerpt; verify)
sources.alpha: Mean of the trial's total losses after 4 months at ambient (26.66% and 35.87%), Gorrepati et al., same source as sl_ref_hours. Ambient storage loss, not trip loss: calibrate with FPO data
sources.harvest_cost_rs_per_kg: Midpoint of Rs 300-400 per quintal for harvest labour plus transport, quoted by a Nashik farmer, FreshPlaza, 3 May 2016, https://www.freshplaza.com/north-america/article/2157335/indian-onion-crisis-farmers-dumping-produce (one farmer, 2016; replace with FPO interview)
sources.water_l_per_kg: 345 L/kg global average (green 192, blue 88, grey 65), Mekonnen and Hoekstra 2010, Value of Water Report 47 Vol 1, Table 4, https://ayhoekstra.nl/pubs/Report47-WaterFootprintCrops-Vol1.pdf
sources.second_life: CLAUDE.md Section 11: dehydration (processor), food bank; Recover: biogas, compost (D19)
